subject: DSM prediction results not read back into Distance

messages.author: 3cc57783657c133b
messages.subject: DSM prediction results not read back into Distance
parts:
Dear Distance users and developers,

I have encountered erroneous behaviour of the Distance program. When using a DSM model for prediction, the analysis seems to run ok: it sends a job to R, and after completion reads the results back, and population estimate (N) appears in the project browser's Analyses tab. However, in the grid data layer, the prediction column does not contain any valid data. The software has added a column for the prediction results, but all values in this column are -1.
I checked that the commands have run correctly in R and the R workspace contains correct prediction outputs, but for some reason, they are not read back into Distance.
Has someone experienced this before? What can possibly cause this?

best wishes
Ainars Aunins

messages.author: 7482eee8d2863d12
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] DSM prediction results not read back into Distance
parts:
Just to close the loop on this topic, for now:

It turns out that what Ainars described is a problem we've encountered
before in this context, and is caused by a bug when passing prediction
results back from R (which runs DSM models) back to Distance for
Windows. The bug manifests itself only in Windows systems where the
regional settings are set such that a decimal place is represented by a
comma. A workaround is to set the regional setting in Windows to
English (UK) or similar while running predictions.

The bug is described in more detail here
https://github.com/DistanceDevelopment/distance-bugs/issues/200

It has been scheduled to be fixed in the next release of Distance for
Windows (which is currently scheduled for the end of this year).

With best wishes, Len Thomas

An update on this issue.

We have now implemented the fix and have a dll which can be distributed to fix this issue in the short term before the next release of Distance.
The fix involves replacing the dll with the bug with our newly compiled one.

If you are struggling with this issue and would like a copy of the new dll and instructions for installing it, please get in touch with us at:


Best wishes,
Laura Marshall
